text: The clinical picture is classic for micturition syncope, a type of reflex syncope, given the trigger, rapid recovery, and absence of other symptoms. REQUEST TEST: Electrocardiogram

text: The normal electrocardiogram further supports a benign cause and rules out cardiac arrhythmia.
